name: Infernal Shrines
theme: Secure the active Shrine and defeat its Guardians to unleash a devastating Punisher against the enemy base.
firstObjective: Warning at 1:45, spawns at 2:15 (~1:45 cooldown after a Punisher is defeated)
spawnPattern: 3 fixed Shrine locations (Top, Mid & Bottom); cycles between Arcane, Mortar (Fire), and Frozen Punishers

mechanic.title: The Punisher Shrines
mechanic.description: Defeat Shrine Guardians inside the active Shrine zone to earn progress toward summoning a Punisher—the team that reaches 100% first awakens a Punisher that leaps onto targets, prioritizes enemy Heroes when attacked or nearby, and attacks structures with a specialized affix (Arcane lasers, Mortar explosions, or Frozen rings).

camps.name: Siege Giants (2 Camps)
camps.notes: Located near the side lanes. Ranged siege mercenaries that provide steady lane pressure while teams position for upcoming Shrine phases.

camps.name: Bruisers / Khazra Camp (2 Camps)
camps.notes: Located in the upper/lower jungle paths. Pairs ranged spear-throwers with a durable melee bruiser to push lanes and clear waves.

strategy: Infernal Shrines heavily favors strong AoE waveclear and sustain to clear Shrine Guardians fast while contesting the circle. Clear side waves and capture Siege or Bruiser camps just before a Shrine activates so lane pressure forces enemies into split rotations, and decide whether to peel/fight inside the Shrine or poke enemies down before committing.
notes: Once summoned, the Punisher leaps toward targets and can be kited or body-blocked slightly around walls, while its affix (Arcane, Mortar, or Frozen) changes how dangerous standing still or clumping is during a push—avoid getting caught in repeated Arcane beams or Mortar bursts while defending.
